description_en: Queries the tags bound to one or more AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters, or the AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters bound to one or more tags
description_zh: 调用ListTagResources查询一个或多个AnalyticDB MySQL集群已绑定的标签列表，或者查询一个或多个标签绑定的AnalyticDB MySQL集群列表
kebab_example: aliyun adb list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type cluster --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query available region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，您可通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Valid value: cluster
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型定义。唯一取值：cluster
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The token used to retrieve more results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query. If a query does not return all results, you can pass the token returned from the previous query in a subsequent query to continue the query
parameters.help_zh: 用来返回更多结果。第一次查询不需要提供这个参数，如果一次查询没有返回全部结果，则可在后续查询中传入前一次返回的Token继续查询
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID. You can specify multiple cluster IDs at a time. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.
You must specify at least one of the ResourceId.N and Tag.N.Key parameters
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。支持同时传入多个集群ID，N的取值范围为：1~50。
ResourceId.N参数和Tag.N.Key参数至少传入一个
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key. You can specify multiple tag keys at a time. Empty strings are not allowed. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

You must specify at least one of the ResourceId.N and Tag.N.Key parameters
fields.help_zh:
标签键。支持同时传入多个标签键，不允许传入空字符串。N的取值范围为：1~20。

ResourceId.N参数和Tag.N.Key参数至少传入一个
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value corresponding to the tag key. You can specify multiple tag values at a time. Empty strings are allowed. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh: 标签键对应的标签值。支持同时传入多个标签值，允许传入空字符串。N的取值范围为：1~20
fields.name: value

NextToken.description_en: The token used to retrieve more results. If a query does not return all results, you can pass the token returned from the previous query in a subsequent query to continue the query
NextToken.description_zh: 用来返回更多结果。如果一次查询没有返回全部结果，则可在后续查询中传入前一次返回的token继续查询
